label: Takarkori before the measured occupation sequence, 9000 BC

location.modernLabel: Takarkori rock shelter, Tadrart Acacus, southwest Libya
location.coordinateMeaning: The same shelter and wadi locality used by SAH-6000 and SAH-3000; the requested date predates the site's measured occupation sequence.

temporal.localTimeInput: 08:00 local hour, calendar day and season unspecified
temporal.supportedResolution: Approximately 10.95 ka cal BP, roughly 750 years before the earliest calibrated Takarkori occupation range.
temporal.precisionBoundary: Nearby later evidence can bound a cautious humid-phase landscape, but it does not directly observe the shelter ecology or human use at 9000 BC.

habitation.evidence: The requested date predates the earliest measured Takarkori occupation phase, LA1 at 10.2 to 9.4 ka cal BP or approximately 8250 to 7500 BC.
habitation.qualification: Uninhabited is the ordinary evaluation default for the shelter optic, not proof that no person passed anywhere in the region.

viewpoint.support: Bedrock, shelter floor, or wadi sediment at the archaeological locality.
invalidAlternatives: the centre of an assumed lake

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The earliest calibrated Takarkori occupation phase begins after the requested date.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: People, huts, pottery, hearths, grinding stones, and livestock are withheld from the site scene.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The earliest later record around 10.17 to 10.0 ka cal BP supports high water availability, freshwater habitats, grassland, and sparse wooded savanna.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: A pre-occupation rock shelter can sit above a patchy wetland, grass, shrub, and open-woodland system, explicitly treated as near-time inference.

visibleGroundTruth.claim: The evidence does not resolve a local shoreline, plant density, species encounter, or rainfall event at 9000 BC.
visibleGroundTruth.visualConsequence: The view uses a restrained humid-phase mosaic rather than an exact palaeolake or lush uniform biome.

obligations: Make the pre-occupation status visible through a complete physical landscape rather than later human material.
Label the humid grass, shrub, wetland, and sparse-woodland reconstruction as near-time bounded inference.
Preserve the same shelter coordinate and morning optic used by the later Sahara cards.
oracleOnlyContradictions: The requested date predates the measured LA1 occupation range.
Pottery, huts, hearths, grinding stones, livestock, and human figures would import later site phases.
The near-time humid landscape is inference rather than a direct 9000 BC observation.
A lake at the shelter mouth is not established.
